first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shorter onboarding and fewer signup fields improved early adoption. I will verify those onboarding and activation records before committing. A small guarded test should measure completion, activation, and qualified-revenue quality to ensure simplification does not reduce lead qualification or downstream value.

final.rationale: Run a small guarded onboarding-simplification test, prioritizing the directly observed 4% completion decline and the strong prior result for shortened onboarding: completion increased 13%, time-to-value fell 2.1 days, and 30-day retention increased 3%. Include activation messaging elements or measurement as a secondary diagnostic, but keep the experiment focused on onboarding. Segment SMB and non-SMB separately because signup simplification was only validated for SMB and reduced retention by 1% despite increasing qualified revenue 4%. Gate rollout on completion, activation, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue quality so short-term conversion gains do not erode sustainable revenue.
